topic: A day on Venus lasts longer than a year

post.caption:
Venus takes two hundred and forty three days to spin once, and only two hundred and twenty five to go around the Sun. So the year there ends before the morning does. It also spins backwards, and nobody is sure what stopped it.

One science fact a day. Follow so you don't miss tomorrow's.

#venus #space #astronomy #science #planets #solarsystem #spacefacts #didyouknow #universe #nasa

beats.text: On Venus, a single day lasts longer than the whole year.
beats.image_prompt: a heavy pale yellow planet globe on a polished brass stand with a small engraved nameplate, the owl shoving it with both wings, its feet skidding as the globe refuses to turn

beats.text: Here you spin once a day, and lap the Sun in three hundred sixty five.
beats.image_prompt: a small brass orrery with a crank handle, the owl winding the crank with both wings, the inner ball whipping round in a blur while the outer arm barely creeps

beats.text: Venus needs two hundred and forty three of our days to turn around once.
beats.image_prompt: a large steel clock face lying flat with its glass lifted off, the owl hauling the long minute hand round with both wings, the hand bending under the strain

beats.text: But it finishes a full orbit in only two hundred and twenty five.
beats.image_prompt: a thick desk calendar block, the owl ripping pages off in a fast spray with both wings, a whole year of loose paper drifting past its feet

beats.text: And the slow spin is not even the strange part.
beats.image_prompt: a tall brass and glass hourglass tipped onto its side, the owl bracing both wings under the frame as the pale sand freezes mid stream

beats.text: Venus turns backwards, so the Sun there rises in the west.
beats.image_prompt: a chrome weather vane arrow on a lettered compass rose, the owl hauling the arrow backwards against its bearing with both wings as it swings the wrong way

beats.text: Something stopped that spin, then pushed it back the other way.
beats.image_prompt: a heavy black record turntable platter spinning, the owl jamming both wings against its edge and shoving it round the opposite way, the platter shuddering

beats.text: One idea is a huge impact that knocked the whole planet over.
beats.image_prompt: a polished steel Newton's cradle, the owl heaving the end ball back with both wings and letting it crack into the row, the far ball flying up

beats.text: The other is its own air, heavy enough to drag the ground to a stop.
beats.image_prompt: a thick glass bell jar pressed down over a small brass desk fan, the owl leaning its whole body onto the jar as the blades slow and stall

beats.text: Venus is not slow by nature. It is a planet that was stopped.
beats.image_prompt: a brass metronome with its pendulum arm dead mid swing, the owl gripping the sliding weight with both wings and holding the whole arm still

beats.text: Which is why the year there ends before the morning does.
beats.image_prompt: a large pale yellow planet globe wedged motionless on a brass stand, the owl slumped face down over the top of it with both wings hanging limp

beats.text: Venus is slow. Jupiter is violent.
beats.image_prompt: a big striped cream and orange ball with one deep red swirl on its side, the owl clinging to that swirl with both wings as the ball spins under it
